comparison.objective: Set a strap clamp level on a step block beside a part versus commission an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Place and support clamp components at matched height versus insert a hex key, counterhold, adjust a collar, lock, and diagnose repeated stops.
comparison.success_condition: Step block and strap must be arranged level; candidate requires two safe repeatable cycles and a retained setting.
comparison.reason: Fixture setup and height matching differ from dynamic calibration; the record gives no numeric level tolerance or detailed scorer.
